lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately seven vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with 4-5 blobs per column forming a rectangular grid on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Linear vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes that define a mesh-like pattern across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank; each ridge exhibits a sharp horizontal intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and a deep shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Small, scattered high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, showing a lower spatial density compared to the adjacent trunk patterning.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp transition in spot morphology is visible, moving from high-density, small-diameter spots on the anterior head region to larger, organized clusters on the trunk.
